name: data_attach
description: Attach a CSV or JSON data file: copy it into the bundle's `data/` and declare it as a source charts and tables name as `@id`, each column typed (inferred from its values without `schema`).

bundle.description: The bundle: a directory, a `.scaena` zip, or a `deck.json`.

id.description: The source's id, which charts and tables name as `@id`.

file.description: The CSV or JSON file (an array of objects) to copy in.

schema.description:
Each column's type: `number`, `string`, `date`, or `boolean`. Without it, each is
typed as narrowly as all its values allow, a date in ISO 8601.

parse.description: A date column's format, for dates not in ISO 8601 (`docs/spec/format.md`).

Finding.description: One lint finding, shaped for agents: a code, a JSON pointer, and (when safe) a fix.

file.description: The bundle file `path` points into, when it is not `deck.json` (a theme file).

format.description: The format the deck was laid out in (`"9:16"`), when it is not the deck's own.

fix.description: A JSON Patch (RFC 6902) that resolves the finding. Only safe, non-content fixes.

attached.description: Whether it was written: not when it would make the deck invalid (in `added`).

schema.description: Each column's type, as the deck declares it.

added.description: What `validate` and `lint` find after it that they did not before.

removed.description: What they found before that they do not after.

errors.description: The findings that are errors, after.
